ja272:1.1: Yena mittena saṃsaggā yogakkhemo vihiṃsati pubbe v' ajjhābhavan tassa rakkhe akkhīva paṇḍito.
ja272:2.1: Yena mittena saṃsaggā yogakkhemo pavaḍḍhati kareyy' attasamaṃ vuttiṃ sabbakiccesu paṇḍito ti.
ja272:3.1: Etha vyagghā nivattavho paccametha mahāvanaṃ, mā vanaṃ chindi nivyagghaṃ, vyagghā mā hesu nibbanā ti.
